component.name: LIFX Panel
component.summary: Control LIFX smart bulbs from your desktop

description.p: LIFX Panel discovers LIFX smart bulbs on your local network and lets you switch them on and off, dim them, tune white color temperature, and set colors — all without a phone or cloud account. Group lights by room, control whole rooms or the whole house at once, and save scenes you can restore with one click.
Optionally, add a LIFX Cloud personal access token to control lights remotely when local discovery is unavailable.
Initial release: local LAN control, rooms, scenes, color wheel, and optional LIFX Cloud support.
